title: TESS single-transit tests: 76 TOI targets and 2 Gaia NSS companion checks
summary: The known-object test queue: 76 TOIs searched for isolated transits and period aliases, plus two Gaia DR3 NSS astrometric companion checks. Every campaign completed and was leaf-verified against its previous run; outcomes per item.
description_md: All 78 campaigns ran through the multi-archive runner (`cygnus.multi`) on this workstation (batch `suite2-2026-09-26`, 78/78 ok) and every committed record was verified leaf-by-leaf against the previous pass: no science value changed. Target positions are Gaia epoch J2015.5 (TOI-6663.01 at J2015.0), audited in `reports/position-epoch-audit-01/`. Lead-level campaigns carry per-lead vetting where it has run; evidence levels are copied verbatim from each record. Run logs live in the local ledger and batch journal (`state/batches/suite2-2026-09-26/`); TOI-2065.01 is a known VSX eclipsing binary (KELT, P = 71.96 d; SIMBAD classifies the host HD 111605 as a spectroscopic binary) and stays rejected.
